verification_program:
import hashlib, json, platform, subprocess
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
import torch
from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download

root=Path.cwd()
torch.set_num_threads(1)
manifest_path=root/'docs/course-experiments/public-models.json'
manifest=json.loads(manifest_path.read_bytes())
model=next(item for item in manifest['models'] if item['id']=='multimodal_distillation')
original=json.loads((root/'outputs/course-student/multimodal-before-task-repair.json').read_bytes())
assert original['old_public_revision'] != model['revision']
roles={'vqa-teacher.pt':'vision','joint-teacher.pt':'joint'}
checks=[]
for prior in original['files']:
    name=prior['filename']
    old_path=Path(hf_hub_download(model['repo'], f'course/course-v1/multimodal_distillation/{name}', revision=original['old_public_revision'], token=False))
    new_path=Path(hf_hub_download(model['repo'], f'course/course-v1/multimodal_distillation/{name}', revision=model['revision'], token=False))
    public=next(item for item in model['files'] if item['output']==name)
    assert hashlib.sha256(old_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==prior['old_public_sha256']
    assert hashlib.sha256(new_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==public['sha256']
    old=torch.load(old_path,map_location='cpu',weights_only=True)
    new=torch.load(new_path,map_location='cpu',weights_only=True)
    assert old['model'].keys()==new['model'].keys()
    assert all(torch.equal(old['model'][key],new['model'][key]) for key in old['model'])
    for field in ('config','modal_config','tokenizer','format_version'):
        assert old.get(field)==new.get(field), field
    expected=roles.get(name,prior['old_task'])
    assert new['task']==new['metadata']['task']==expected
    checks.append({'filename':name,'old_public_sha256':prior['old_public_sha256'],'new_public_sha256':public['sha256'],'old_task':prior['old_task'],'new_task':new['task'],'model_tensors_sha256':prior['model_tensors_sha256'],'all_model_tensors_exactly_equal':True,'inference_configuration_unchanged':True})
proof={'schema_version':1,'checked_at':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'status':'passed','scope':'Anonymous downloads at both immutable revisions; exact tensor-by-tensor equality and identical config/modal_config/tokenizer/format_version for all six files. Only the two missing teacher task declarations are repaired; current provenance metadata is separately regenerated. No retraining or new accuracy estimate.','code_checkout_revision':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),'verification_program':Path(__file__).read_text(),'verification_program_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'environment':{'python':platform.python_version(),'torch':str(torch.__version__),'device':'cpu','torch_threads':'1'},'repo':model['repo'],'old_public_revision':original['old_public_revision'],'new_public_revision':model['revision'],'manifest_sha256':hashlib.sha256(manifest_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'files':checks}
out=root/'docs/course-experiments/student-checks/multimodal-task-repair.json'
out.write_text(json.dumps(proof,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'status':'passed','unchanged_models':len(checks),'old_pin':original['old_public_revision'],'new_pin':model['revision']}))
